text:
sara: Quick async check — we promised a canary window + clear owner list for the v2 compatibility rollout this week. I have a few gaps: mobile SDK PR 842 still needs owner, we need to lock the telemetry gating for canary, and confirm the deprecation date for v1 routes. Can folks drop updates here?
chris: Owner for PR 842 is me, I’ll shepherd the mobile side. Plan to cut the SDK beta branch today.
chris: FYI the change touches header parsing; will add a feature flag so we can A/B by region.
mike: Telemetry gating: I can add a rollout flag to telemetry-service but need the exact metric list. sara — can you paste the eval set we want to watch?
sara: Sending eval set below. We care about: prompt-preservation, token-shift regressions, latency P95, error-rate by route. Also track client-side fallback counts.
sara: eval_list: [small_prompts, long_chat, embeddings_heavy]
julia: Deprecation date: legal asked for a 90-day notice after final docs publish. We had doc-publish targeted for 2026-05-10, so deprec date would be ~2026-08-08. Is that still okay?
chris: 90 days is fine. We should announce a migration checklist in Console on publish too. I can own the console blurb.
mike: Telemetry flags: I'll add these metrics and wire an alert for token-shift > 2% and latency P95 > 20% over baseline. Which channel for alerts? eng-sre or eng-runtime?
julia: eng-sre for uptime/latency, eng-runtime for model regressions. Put both.
sara: Canary window: propose 48h in us-west region, then expand to eu-west for 24h, then global. Owners:
- canary ops: chris
- telemetry & alerts: mike
- rollback plan: julia
- SDK outreach: chris (mobile) + sara (web)
chris: Sounds good. For the 48h window, I’ll use the feature flag service. Quick toggle command I’ll use for infra team:```bash
# enable canary for us-west
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"flag":"v2_canary_us_west","state":"on","percent":10}'
```
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-proxy v2 -> us-west cluster at 2026-04-20T09:30Z (CI green).
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 10% traffic -> v2_proxy_shim on us-west (slot a).
sara: SDK status: web SDK has a compatibility shim in 1.3.2, mobile needs bump to 1.4.0-beta. Chris — can you open a short note for external integrators?
chris: Will do. Drafting now, will link here when ready.
mike: One blocker: redis KV caching behavior differs for streaming responses in v2; I’m adding a unit test but needs a runtime patch. If that patch misses the canary window, we should gate streaming for canary. Thoughts?
julia: Gate streaming in canary — we want to avoid cascade surprises. If the runtime patch lands in next 12h, we can un-gate.
sara: Agree. Marking streaming disabled for initial 48h canary. Chris — flag that in the console blurb.
chris: Done, added a note: "Streaming disabled during initial canary. We expect parity after runtime patch."
mike: Patch PR 879 opened for redis streaming fix, @chris can you hold off canary unblock until CI and perf tests pass?
chris: Yup, will hold.
sara: Action items recap:
- chris: SDK beta branch + console blurb + mobile integrator note
- mike: telemetry flags + alerts + merge PR 879 tests
- julia: finalize deprecation calendar + publish docs by 2026-05-10
- infra-bot: execute canary deploy at 2026-04-20T09:30Z (us-west)
Please update status by EOD. :thumbsup:
